previous_versions.body: Agree with @elarlang that this is covered in #996. We even have a PR with some proposed changes in #1494. Please check if anything you have mentioned is not in that issue or PR and comment there. I am going to close this as a duplicate for now. I would particiularly be interested in input on how we can focus down the fewest important requirements as I believe the proposed section may currently be too large and complicated.
